title: Old-Time Jam @ Bike Bar Ithaca
event_description: A weekly old-time and traditional fiddle jam led by Joe Hayward and friends at this bicycle-themed downtown Ithaca taproom. Acoustic string players of all levels are welcome to sit in.
backline: Acoustic jam; bring your own fiddle, banjo or guitar
event_venue_information:
Bike Bar Ithaca

Bike Bar is a bicycle-themed taproom in downtown Ithaca pouring a dozen rotating craft beers alongside cocktails, wine and cider, with charcuterie and cheese plates to snack on. Bicycle frames and wheels double as decor throughout the room, giving the bar a distinct, hobbyist identity among Ithaca's downtown drinking spots.

Old-Time Jam

Every Tuesday evening, fiddler Joe Hayward and friends lead an old-time music jam, drawing acoustic string players from around Tompkins County for a night of traditional fiddle tunes. It's an informal, pull-up-a-chair session rather than a stage show, and newcomers with a fiddle, banjo or guitar are welcome to sit in.

Other Events

Bike Bar also books scheduled live sets spanning jazz, reggae and folk throughout the month, in addition to its weeknight happy hour.

Good to Know

Bike Bar is located at 314 E State St, Ithaca, NY 14850, in the heart of downtown. The old-time jam is casual and typically wraps up by around 8:00 PM.

title: Bluegrass Night @ Liquid State Brewing Company
event_description: A bluegrass and old-time picking session on select Monday evenings at this West End Ithaca brewery, welcoming string players for a relaxed night of acoustic tunes.
backline: Acoustic jam; bring your own instrument
event_venue_information:
Liquid State Brewing Company

Liquid State Brewing Company is a 2,800-square-foot beer hall and patio in Ithaca's West End District, pouring house-brewed beer alongside a small-plates menu and rotating local food trucks. The brewery has built a reputation as a community gathering spot for West End residents and visitors alike.

Bluegrass Night

On select Monday evenings, Liquid State hosts a Bluegrass Night jam session welcoming pickers and string players for an evening of acoustic bluegrass and old-time tunes, typically running from about 5:30 PM to 8:30 PM.

Other Events

The brewery's weekly calendar also includes Irish sessions with Six Mile Craic, a comedy open mic, trivia night and the recurring Astronomy on Tap lecture series, making it one of the more eclectic community-events hubs in Ithaca.

Good to Know

Liquid State Brewing Company is located at 620 West Green St, Ithaca, NY 14850. Because Bluegrass Night runs on select Mondays rather than every week, check the brewery's event calendar before visiting.

title: Open Mic Night @ The Nocturnal Cafe
event_description: A free, alcohol-free weekly open mic at Ithaca's only sober nightlife spot, featuring a rotating cast of local musicians, storytellers and poets in a cozy, all-ages room.
event_venue_information:
The Nocturnal Café

The Nocturnal Café is an all-ages, alcohol-free espresso and tea bar in downtown Ithaca, evolved from the longtime Sacred Root Kava Lounge & Tea Bar. Billing itself as “Ithaca's only alcohol-free nightlife destination,” the café leans into a cozy, underground feel with twinkling lights and couches spread across several small rooms.

Wednesday Open Mic Night

Every Wednesday from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM, the café hosts a free open mic featuring a rotating cast of local performers sharing songs, stories and spoken word in front of a welcoming, supportive audience. Slots tend to fill quickly with regulars, so arriving early is recommended.

Other Events

Beyond the weekly open mic, The Nocturnal Café hosts live music and art nights, including DJ and groove sets, catering to Ithaca's all-ages and sober-curious crowd.

Good to Know

The Nocturnal Café is located at 103 S Geneva St, Ithaca, NY 14850. As an alcohol-free, all-ages venue, it's an especially good option for younger performers and anyone looking for a substance-free night out.

title: Open Mic Night @ The Westy
event_description: A 21-and-up weekly open mic in a relaxed West End bar with a beer garden, pool table and piano. Starts mellow and builds into a lively, sociable late set.
backline: House piano available; PA and microphone provided
event_venue_information:
The Westy

The Westy is a neighborhood bar in Ithaca's West End, known for its wide craft beer selection, spacious beer garden, darts, pool table, pinball machine and a piano in the corner of the room. It has a relaxed, come-as-you-are atmosphere typical of a good local hangout.

Open Mic Night

On Tuesday nights from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM, The Westy hosts a 21-and-up open mic that starts out relaxed and builds into a lively, sociable crowd as the night goes on — a good option for performers who want a real bar-room energy rather than a quiet listening room.

Other Events

The Westy's beer garden and game room also host casual live music and community gatherings throughout the week.

Good to Know

The Westy is located at 516 W State St, Ithaca, NY 14850. The open mic is 21-and-up, so bring ID.

title: Open Mic Night @ Crossroads Bar & Grille
event_description: A weekly Thursday open mic hosted by Benny T at this family-style bar and grille in Lansing, a short drive from downtown Ithaca, drawing local acoustic and full-band performers.
event_venue_information:
Crossroads Bar & Grille

Crossroads Bar & Grille is a family-style restaurant and bar in Lansing, just a short drive north of downtown Ithaca, known for a welcoming, neighborhood atmosphere and a full food and drink menu.

Open Mic Night

On Thursday evenings, Crossroads hosts an open mic led by Benny T, drawing musicians from Lansing, Ithaca and the surrounding Tompkins County towns for a casual night of live acoustic and full-band performances.

Other Events

Crossroads is a regular stop for local bands and community events throughout the year, serving as one of the more consistent live-music venues just outside Ithaca proper.

Good to Know

Crossroads Bar & Grille is located at 3120 N Triphammer Road, Lansing, NY 14882, about a 10-minute drive from downtown Ithaca.
